user_instruction: 固定这个候选算法，即候选路径的数量无限制
candidate_definition: Original adjacent-layer source Head to downstream label-K pathways
candidate_pool: All pathways admitted by the original definition for the current model architecture

ranking.metric: Mean singleton cross-entropy gain over the original two protection data settings

prefixes: Every ranked prefix k=1..N, where N is the actual full candidate count

coverage.definition: Minimum over protection data settings of mean set gain divided by mean full donor gain

selection_rule: Smallest prefix reaching target; otherwise highest finite coverage, ties smaller k
no_finite_coverage_rule: Retain existing choose_prefix fallback to the first ranked path and report the condition
artifact_scope: Code-only release; scientific data and results are external.
